Hand directions and geometry audit

Blue: hand axis · Orange: palm normal · Green: index direction. Axes use the default view (+X right, +Y up, +Z toward viewer, camera pitch 0.18 rad). A curled index finger need not point along the hand axis.

The viewer selects 10 Hz samples plus peak-crossing frames. The underlying audit ran at 120 Hz. Triangle-pair counts and crossing spans are diagnostics, not penetration depth or automatic severity scores.
